verdict.rationale: Flagright's Management API documents case status transitions that include CLOSED and REOPENED, and alert hits can be set to CLEARED. That covers resolving and reopening a decision. However, nothing in the pack shows an audit trail or history recording who changed the decision and why, nor a false-positive closure reason or override mechanism. Missing for 10: documented audit log/history of status changes, explicit false-positive resolution reasons, override workflow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can resolve a false positive and reopen or override the decision with an audit record

citations.quote: The status can be one of the following values: `OPEN`, `CLOSED`, `REOPENED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `ON_HOLD`, or a custom status ID (e.g. `CS-1`).
